s: modern Senegalese cooking that climbed North America's 50 Best
w: Chef Serigne Mbaye's modern Senegalese restaurant, tracing West African foodways through the Louisiana table with real technical ambition -- confident enough to land high on the 2026 North America's 50 Best Restaurants list. A distinctly New Orleans evolution: the city's deep culinary layering pushed forward rather than replayed.
_facts: Located at 937 Leonidas St, New Orleans, LA 70118, Uptown
Run by chef Serigne Mbaye, serving modern Senegalese cuisine
